food-cattail-soup.prompt: Create one refined food illustration for a Chinese travel-food catalog. Subject: 奶汤蒲菜 (Jinan stewed cattail shoots in milky broth), NOT bamboo shoot soup. A single low broad white porcelain soup bowl, creamy ivory bone broth, many tender ivory-green cattail shoot sections about finger length, a few thin pink ham slices, two or three brown shiitake slices, small spring-onion accent. Peaceful Shandong restaurant wooden tabletop, warm soft daylight. Elevated three-quarter close view, dish fills most of a horizontal composition, no text, no logo, no watermark, no collage, no people. Beautiful editorial watercolor and gouache illustration with naturally detailed food textures; clearly an illustration rather than a claimed restaurant photograph. Show only the cooked finished dish, no raw ingredients laid out. This will appear on a compact travel app food card. Aim for landscape 3:2 aspect.
